bugs_found: loan_payment raises base Exception for negative principal instead of ValueError, breaking callers that handle validation failures via ValueError
transfer mutates account_from before mutating account_to, so a failure during credit update can debit without crediting; transfer is not atomic
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float amounts cause TypeError with Decimal balances or mixed numeric behavior
fx_convert accepts zero or negative exchange rates and silently returns zero/negative converted amounts
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing requested terms without validation
compound_interest does not reject negative principal
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
